name: NoVA Square-1 Showdown 2024
information: The Community Space is located in the back of University Mall, directly underneath Giant Food and next to Patriot Pawsabilities. Available seating will be limited. You may bring your own folding chair (or similar) if you wish to guarantee a seat. Square-1 is the main event, but we will only be able to have 3 rounds as scheduled if there are 16 or more competitors who compete in the event.
